{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Silencer-7'', this is Imperial Star Destroyer ''Allegiance''! Rebel forces have&mdash;|Last transmission from the ''Allegiance''|<ref name="Dark Empire (audio)" />}}
A man served as a '''crew member''' aboard the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Allegiance (Allegiance-class)|''Allegiance'']] during the [[Battle of Calamari]]. He attempted to send a message to the [[World Devastator]] ''[[Silencer-7]]'' after [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] jumped in-system, but was cut off when the New Republic [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Emancipator]]'' opened fire on the ''Allegiance''.<ref name="Dark Empire (audio)" />
